title: Puzzle 2d Deselect Performance
summary: Made puzzle 2d background deselect fast by (1) Tree per-row selection via TreeSelectionStore + useSyncExternalStore so hierarchy rows no longer all re-render on selection change, (2) WASM world_content_cache uses neutral geometry with selection/preselect/hover painted as O(selected) overlay without bumping content_scene_generation on selection setters, (3) stable Puzzle2dPlayCanvasSelectionContext so triptych pane canvases skip React re-render on selection-only updates. Tests: ui/react (91), puzzle/2d/rs cargo (88), puzzle/2d/react (112).
